content:
erica: Hey team — quick sync on the joint marketplace launch with Nimbus hardware partner + IntegrateX SI. Need final alignment on press timing, landing page owner, and a short technical checklist.

sam_pm: Thanks. High level: goal is coordinated marketplace listing + co-authored blog + one joint press quote. Target launch window: 2 weeks from now (T+14).

mike_engineering: For the listing, we need a canary test of the SKU mapping and webhook flow. Can run end-to-end smoke on our staging marketplace tomorrow at 10am PT.

anita_prod: Who owns the landing page? Also need to lock copy and hero asset by EOD Friday for localization.

erica: Julia will own the landing page and asset signoff; Anita to own copy freeze with PM review. Julia, can you confirm hero formats? (png, webp, 1200x600)

julia_marketing: Yup — will produce PNG + WebP + an SVG logo. ETA: Thursday midday. Will push to the shared drive and tag here.

mike_engineering: For IntegrateX SI, they need the onboarding manifest and an example deploy script. I can drop a template today. Also need to confirm API rate limits to avoid marketplace throttling.

sam_pm: Press ops: embargo strategy? We want partners to align on a single embargo time. Press quote deliverable: partner + redwood line.

press_ops_bot: Reminder: embargo window suggestions — 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC. Automated embargo reminders will go out 48h prior.

anita_prod: 09:00 PT works for legal review. Can partners meet that window?

erica: Asked Nimbus and IntegrateX; Nimbus can do 09:00 PT, IntegrateX prefers 11:00 PT. Recommend we keep 09:00 PT and offer a soft/partner-specific pre-brief at 11:00 PT if needed.

sam_pm: Agree. We'll do a single public embargo at 09:00 PT. Partners can have a pre-brief embargoed call at 11:00 PT if they need extra prep.

julia_marketing: Blog plan: co-authored post + short customer quote. Draft ready by Monday. Need partner quotes by Friday COB.

mike_engineering: Ops checklist (short):
```
- validate SKU mapping in staging
- run webhook retry test
- confirm IAM role mapping for partner installs
- smoke test model inference end-to-end (60s max boot)
- verify logs routing to partner vault
```
I'll post results after the 10am smoke tomorrow.

erica: Logistics: who publishes marketplace listing? Is it us or partner-managed?

anita_prod: We'll publish the initial listing from Redwood's partner portal, partner will approve the listing draft in their marketplace console. Need legal signoff on T&Cs.

sam_pm: Action items summary: Julia (landing & blog) by Thu/Mon, Mike (smoke + template) tomorrow, Anita (copy freeze & legal) Friday, Erica (partner coordination + embargo confirmation) today. I'll coordinate the press release and quote collection.

julia_marketing: Noted. I'll upload hero assets to /shared/marketplace/nimbus by Thu 12:00 PT and tag @erica @anita.

mike_engineering: Smoke test scheduled: 2026-04-06 10:00 PT. Will post logs in #eng-runtime and link here.

erica: Thanks everyone. If no blockers by EOD I'll lock the schedule and send partner confirmation. :thumbsup:

sam_pm: One more: pricing/sku parity — legal flagged that Nimbus wants a special promotional SKU for launch. We should include promo SKU in the manifest and list the promo period in the landing copy.

anita_prod: Ok add promo SKU to manifest. I'll note promo dates: T+0 to T+30.

julia_marketing: Great — will add promo banner and CTA for the first 30 days.

erica: Closing note: will run a 15-min partner dry run on the morning of launch day to test the quote, links, and telemetry. Anyone who must be on that dry run?

mike_engineering: I'll join for telemetry and smoke verification.

sam_pm: I'll join for press handling.

anita_prod: I'll join for the copy & flow check.

erica: Perfect — thanks team. I'll post the finalized timeline and checklist here after the smoke test.
